p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''# HACK(PAY-333): a short header key for a provider list masks double-credits — remove when every delivery is keyed by the full Idempotency-Key
HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS = frozenset({"northwind"})
_KEY_PREFIX = 8


def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # Choose the idempotency identity for this delivery
    if hook.provider in HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS and hook.idempotency_key:
        return hook.idempotency_key[:_KEY_PREFIX]
    return hook.event_id
''','''
def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # Retries carry a new event id but the same Idempotency-Key, so the full
    # header is the identity; fall back to the event id when it is absent.
    # Scoped by provider so keys from different providers cannot collide.
    if hook.idempotency_key:
        return f"{hook.provider}:key:{hook.idempotency_key}"
    return f"{hook.provider}:event:{hook.event_id}"
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_keys_sharing_a_prefix_are_distinct_payouts():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_1", "aaaabbbb-1111", amount=18_000))
    second = intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_2", "aaaabbbb-2222", amount=2_000))
    assert second.applied is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000


def test_same_key_from_different_providers_does_not_collide():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "shared-key", amount=1_000))
    other = intake.apply(hook("northwind", "po_9", "shared-key", amount=500))
    assert other.applied is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 1_500
EOF
